paper: A Multimodal Foundation Agent for Financial Trading: Tool-Augmented, Diversified, and Generalist
headline_strategy: Multimodal LLM trading agent combining market-intelligence summaries, price charts, three-level memory with diversified retrieval, low- and high-level reflection, strategy tools, and a final BUY/HOLD/SELL decision
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable from released inputs and outputs without replacing the central multimodal decision policy
missing_headline_objects: the exact Financial Modeling Prep price/news/fundamental input snapshot
paper-time multimodal market-intelligence records and rendered decision images
FinAgent memories, retrieval state, and reflection trajectories
paper-time model endpoints or an author-approved replacement policy
native agent decisions, action/equity paths, checkpoints, and result tables
a paper-defined cross-sectional portfolio combining 1,000 stock agents
material_source_conflicts: Validation charts use mode=train and expose 14 future days to the vision-reflection path.
The released environment is long-only although the paper explains a TSLA short position.
Loaded optimized rule parameters are overwritten by a default-parameter signal call.
Twenty-one asset-list references and three processor/downloader routes are broken.
Released Sharpe, Calmar, and Sortino formulas do not match the paper equations.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the released Buy-and-Hold or technical-rule strategies
rejected_substitutes.reason: They are paper comparators/tool components, not outputs of the multimodal FinAgent decision policy; the 90 opaque rule records also match 0 of 288 comparable appendix cells.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the controlled BUY/HOLD/SELL environment run
rejected_substitutes.reason: It validates accounting mechanics on a synthetic action sequence but generates no agent decision.
The 13 of 36 matched unique cells use present-day Yahoo responses, not the paper's FMP snapshot, and carry no FinAgent result credit.

rejected_substitutes.route: Run a modern LLM using only JKP characteristics and monthly charts
rejected_substitutes.reason: This omits the paper's market-intelligence corpus, multimodal memories, diversified retrieval, reflection state, and native daily timing while adding a new portfolio rule.

rejected_substitutes.route: Use the released validation chart path literally
rejected_substitutes.reason: It exposes future prices and would violate the common no-lookahead contract.

result_policy: No baseline, rule record, synthetic environment action, or generic JKP policy is entered as a FinAgent monthly return. This prevents either a false failure claim or unjustified credit for the paper's reported positive performance.
